description: Sanitation needs a vermin tally for the yards, and by 'needs' they mean a number to file. Count the rats down Reefer Row, Container Row, and the Sidings. Round up if it's scary. 15₵.
name: Vermin Census

objectives.desc: Tally the rats on Reefer Row
emotes: {who} crouches by a reefer unit, counting glowing eyes in the dark and adding a few for luck.
{who} bangs a pipe to flush the rats out, then loses count immediately.
{who} tallies a fat one twice, feels bad, tallies it a third time.

objectives.desc: Tally the rats on Container Row
emotes: {who} peers into a container gap, counts a writhing mass, and just writes 'lots.'
{who} follows a chittering sound down Container Row, stylus poised, dignity gone.
{who} startles as something the size of a dog is definitely NOT a rat and moves on quickly.

objectives.desc: Tally the rats on the Sidings
emotes: {who} counts the last of them along the Sidings and underlines the total twice.
{who} totals the tally, realizes it's more rats than the district has people, and shrugs.
{who} files the count under 'concerning' and gets the hell out of the Sidings.
